CHANGELOG updated in IDUNA: fix(device-auth): real time.Time round-trip bug breaking every SQLite device-auth poll -- found live building BIG_O's IDUNA app, root-caused via an isolated modernc.org/sqlite repro (time.Time scanned back from a TEXT column always failed, meaning the live poll flow never actually worked for any real caller). Fixed to match internal/store/sqlite.go's own already-proven RFC3339Nano format/parse convention. New store_sqlite_test.go closes the real test gap (service_test.go's fakeStore never exercised real SQL). go build/vet/test all clean. NOT yet deployed to the live service -- blocked as a production-deploy action, needs a human restart. (sess-20260923-1030-4a526255)

⚓ ☃
